description: health_check_v2.select_fix_recipe adds two issue kinds ('api_rate_limit' → /model haiku-4-5, 'backoff' → escalate_via_bot2bot) that REQ-H3(a)..(g) does not enumerate. classify_issue_from_snapshot also emits these. The spec lists exactly 7 issue classes (a..g); the implementation adds 2 more without a corresponding REQ. While these are reasonable behaviors, they are spec-undefined; PROP-H3 dispatch correctness is therefore not auditable against an authoritative source. Either the spec must be extended to include them, or the implementation should drop them.
